rules.title: Valid document skeleton
rules.text: Include doctype, lang attribute, charset and viewport meta on every page.

rules.title: Heading hierarchy
rules.text: Use one h1 and a logical heading hierarchy.

rules.title: Landmarks
rules.text: Use header, nav, main and footer landmarks.

rules.title: Lazy images
rules.text: Set width, height and loading="lazy" on below-the-fold images.

rules.title: SEO metadata
rules.text: Provide title, description and canonical metadata for public pages.
